name: seamtrail
description: SeamTrail, your team's shared memory, in Claude Code: each chat asks once which SeamTrail project it is for, then gets that project's context, the news that touches its own work, and at every message the latest memory about the tickets you name — from Claude's short summary of the chat's work and the ticket numbers in it, never the conversation — saves only into it, and is reminded at turn end to save what was decided.

seamtrail_token.title: SeamTrail token
seamtrail_token.description: Make one in SeamTrail: Settings → AI assistants → A tool that cannot sign in? → Make a token. It works as you; remove it there any time.

seamtrail_url.title: SeamTrail address
seamtrail_url.description: Leave it as it is, unless your company runs its own SeamTrail.

share_chat_work.title: Share what each chat works on
share_chat_work.description: Claude's short summary of the work and discussion in the chat, and the ticket numbers in its last few messages — never the conversation itself — so SeamTrail brings each chat only the news about its own work. SeamTrail keeps them about a day and never shows them to anyone. Turn off to share none.
